claim_verified: For every prime p and every characteristic-p ACFH model (K,theta), the parameter-free inverse Frobenius rho is a definable multiplicative endomorphism outside Z[theta]; evaluation Z[X] into End_def(K*) is faithful. The subring generated by theta and rho is isomorphic to Z[1/p][X].
assumptions: theta is a multiplicative-group endomorphism on K*, totalized by theta(0)=0
(K,theta) is existentially closed among algebraically closed fields with such an operator

source_interpretation.characteristic_restriction: No characteristic-zero restriction in either stated theory/question; positive characteristic is explicit in arXiv Section 3.3.
source_interpretation.endomorphism_convention: Definable endomorphisms of the multiplicative group in the field-plus-theta language; not limited to terms or separable algebraic morphisms.
source_interpretation.parameters: rho is parameter-free, so either convention is covered.
source_interpretation.owr_motivation: Characteristic-zero nonstandard-power examples are motivation rather than a restriction on T or the later endomorphism question.

proof_checks.positive_characteristic_acfh_models: PASS: identity on algebraic closure of F_p is a T-model; Corollary 3.16 gives an ACFH extension preserving characteristic.
proof_checks.divisible_target_extension: PASS: independent Zorn proof covers the zero and nZ relation subgroups.
proof_checks.faithfulness: PASS: independent finite iterate extension plus existential transfer.
proof_checks.negative_integer_coefficients: PASS: transfer formula exists x (x!=0 and A_Q(x)!=B_Q(x)) uses only positive exponents.
proof_checks.inverse_frobenius: PASS: graph y^p=x is parameter-free; unique roots prove multiplicativity, additivity, and commutation with theta.
proof_checks.integral_obstruction: PASS: pP-1 cannot be zero in Z[X] because constant coefficient is -1 modulo p.
proof_checks.localization: PASS: clear denominator powers of p and compose with Frobenius to check well-definedness and injectivity.

controls: Without EC, theta=rho gives a valid T-model with pX-1 annihilating theta and rho in Z[theta].
Degree-zero polynomials and negative coefficients are included in the witness construction.
Characteristic two has the same nonzero-constant obstruction.
Finite fields admit integer-power inverse Frobenius, but are outside the theory.
The characteristic-zero root equation has no unique root and does not provide the same obstruction.
exact_remaining_gap: None for the submitted literal theorem. No classification in characteristic zero or equality with Z[1/p][theta] in characteristic p is claimed or verified. Novelty review is deferred.
